property_summary: After an initial deposit of 1 wei by alice via addToBalance(), a second deposit of 2 wei by alice results in userBalance[alice] == 3 in P but userBalance[alice] == 2 in M, because M overwrites rather than increments.
change_summary: Replace userBalance[msg.sender] = add_uint256(...) with direct assignment of msg.value, ignoring previous balance.
